column3: MT 3:19. Close to the Hebrew; “a furnace” is rendered “an oven.”
MT 3:20. NKJV renders “a sun of righteousness … in its wings” as “The Sun of Righteousness … in His wings,” capitalized, and “you will skip” as “grow fat.”
MT 3:21. Close to the Hebrew; “on the day when I act” is rendered “On the day that I do this.”
MT 3:22. Close to the Hebrew; “the instruction of Moses” is rendered “the Law of Moses.”
MT 3:23. Close to the Hebrew; “awesome” is rendered “dreadful.”
MT 3:24. Close to the Hebrew; “the land [with] total destruction” is rendered “the earth with a curse.”
